description: Auditable external SQL corpora for Phase 1. Sources are intentionally stratified: Spider cross-domain text-to-SQL, real tutorial repositories, and JOIN/window/CTE-focused teaching files are all enabled.

sources.name: WikiSQL official archive
sources.license_note: Use according to the upstream WikiSQL repository terms.
sources.bias_risk: Single-table benchmark distribution; useful for projection, aggregation and simple predicates but insufficient for joins, nesting, windows and dialect edges.

sources.name: Spider benchmark (Hugging Face mirror, train)
sources.license_note: Spider is distributed under its upstream license; the mirror is used only as a source of SQL examples.
sources.bias_risk: Cross-domain benchmark distribution; replay requires the official Spider tables.json keyed by db_id, and records without a physical schema are rejected.

sources.name: Spider benchmark (Hugging Face mirror, validation)
sources.license_note: Spider is distributed under its upstream license; the mirror is used only as a source of SQL examples.
